raw.details:
Craft N Code – Chhattisgarh State Qualifier

This State Round is exclusively for students studying in colleges across Chhattisgarh. Please register only if your institution is located in Chhattisgarh.

For important announcements, updates, problem statement notifications, submission details, and other information regarding the Craft N Code – Chhattisgarh State Qualifier, participants are requested to join the official WhatsApp group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/GOj4OSe6oAJHuoq7EggWo5?s=cl&p=a&ilr=1

Get ready to showcase your innovation, creativity, and coding skills at the Craft N Code Chhattisgarh State Qualifier, organized by Shri Shankaracharya Technical Campus (SSTC), Bhilai. This qualifier provides an opportunity for Chhattisgarh's talented student innovators to showcase their skills and compete for a chance to advance to the Craft N Code National Hackathon, hosted by IIIT Bhubaneswar.

The Chhattisgarh State Qualifier will follow a structured evaluation process where teams will get the opportunity to understand the challenge, brainstorm innovative ideas, develop technology-driven solutions, and present their projects. Participants will be evaluated on their problem-solving approach, innovation, technical implementation, creativity, presentation, and overall impact of their solutions.

Important Dates:

  • Registration Opens: 13 August 2026
  • Problem Statement Release: 13 November 2026
  • Submission Window: 21-22 November 2026
  • Results Announcement: 25 November 2026

The problem statement will be released on 13 September 2026, after which participants can begin working on their solutions. Teams will have the submission window from 19 September to 20 September 2026 to finalize and submit their projects.

The results will be announced on 25 September 2026, following the evaluation of the submitted solutions.

Craft N Code is more than just a coding competition—it is a platform for solving real-world problems through technology, collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Participants will get the opportunity to transform their ideas into practical solutions while working alongside talented students and developers from across Chhattisgarh.

What's in it for you?:

  • An opportunity to compete at the Craft N Code State Qualifier
  • A chance to advance toward the Craft N Code National Hackathon at IIIT Bhubaneswar
  • Showcase your creativity and technical expertise
  • Collaborate with talented students and innovators
  • Gain experience solving real-world problem statements
  • Earn certificates and recognition
  • Strengthen your resume and technical portfolio
  • Network with fellow developers and technology enthusiasts

If you're ready to challenge yourself, build innovative solutions, and showcase your technical skills, this is your opportunity to step forward.

Gather your team, register from 13 August 2026, and get ready to Craft N Code!

Mark Your Calendar:

  • 13 August — Registrations Open
  • 13 September — Problem Statement Released
  • 19–20 September — Submission Window
  • 25 September — Results Announced

Make sure to join the group to stay updated with all event-related announcements.

Let's innovate. Let's build. Let's Craft N Code.
